bibl.title: Sull'espressione ἀπὸ στρατηγίων / στρατηγιῶν nelle iscrizioni e nei papiri.
bibl.seg: Fabiola Verrecchia, Sull'espressione ἀπὸ στρατηγίων / στρατηγιῶν nelle iscrizioni e nei papiri.
bibl.note: Clarifies the meaning and the origin of the expression ἀπὸ στρατηγίων / στρατηγιῶν, which appears in a Greek honorific inscription from Jerash (Arabia). Parallels with other documents are proposed (discusses some papyri from Karanis and Oxyrhynchus dating from the first half of the fourth century).
